item.title: Bangladesh observes state mourning for slain Osman Hadi

item.title: Press bodies condemn newspaper attacks, blame government failure
item.description: Dhaka – Two of Bangladesh’s leading press organizations have expressed deep concern in a joint statement over the arson and vandalism attacks on the headquarters of two major newspapers in Dhaka. item.description: Dhaka – Tens of thousands of people gathered at the South Plaza of the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban in Dhaka on Saturday for the funeral prayers of Sharif Osman Hadi, spokesperson for the Inqilab Manch, as Bangladesh observed a day of state mourning in his honor. item.title: Bangladesh’s war hero AK Khandkar passes away at 95
item.description: Dhaka – Retired Air Vice Marshal AK Khandkar, Bir Uttam, Deputy Chief of Staff of Bangladesh’s Liberation War in 1971, passed away on Saturday at the age of 95. item.title: Osman Hadi laid to rest beside national poet Kazi Nazrul

item.title: Tarique Rahman returns home after 17 years in exile

item.title: Tarique Rahman speaks with Chief Adviser Yunus upon return to Bangladesh
item.description: Dhaka – On his arrival in Dhaka from London, Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman spoke by phone with Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus, party officials said on Thursday.
